title: Lakehouse: cert-rotate (vault-agent re-render; MinIO big-bang)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate lakehouse --yes`. Forces each node vault-agent to re-issue its leaf from pki_int and reloads the service. MinIO is re-certed BIG-BANG (all 4 restarted together — a rolling 1-node re-cert breaks distributed MinIO inter-node mTLS); Spark/Nessie/ZK restart; iceberg-pg is deferred to the PG DR runbook by design.

observe.what: new leaf serials on the MinIO/Nessie/Spark/ZK nodes (old != new); iceberg-pg rows show the deliberate DR-runbook skip → the verb exits non-zero on that skip

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.RotateCertAsync forces each vault-agent to re-render its pki_int leaf; MinIO restarts big-bang to preserve distributed inter-node mTLS, the others restart per-node, and iceberg-pg is deferred to its DR runbook (the verb exits non-zero on that documented skip).
